prerequisites.reason: Matrices are a core mathematical concept needed before broader mathematical foundations used in machine learning can be understood.
Learning algorithms rely on underlying mathematical concepts and operations.
Understanding neural networks requires mathematical foundations such as linear algebra and related operations.
Convolutional networks are a specialized type of neural network, so basic neural network concepts are necessary first.
Designing and understanding network architecture presupposes familiarity with neural networks.
Training techniques are applied to neural network models, so understanding neural networks is necessary first.
Training techniques are specific methods for training models and build on the broader concept of learning algorithms.
Feature learning depends on having data represented in a form that can be processed by machine learning models.
